2462:777.name: Slider
2462:777.description:
Core range input track with thumb(s) and optional tooltip(s).

Boolean toggles
- Dual thumbs: switch between single-thumb (point value) and double-thumb (range selection) mode.
- Tooltip left / Tooltip right: show/hide value tooltips above each thumb.
- Touch Area left / Touch Area right: show/hide the invisible hit-area targets for each thumb (keep enabled in production; disable only for static mockups).

Usage notes
Use single-thumb mode for selecting a single value (e.g. volume, brightness). Use dual-thumb mode for selecting a range (e.g. price filter, date span). Always wrap in Slider Field when a label or value display is needed.
